name: First National Bank of Omaha (FNBO) credit cards
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public card.fnbo.com pages only (no log in). Public header 'Log In' leads to 'Online Account Log In' (hosted on auth.securebanklogin.com; its form could not be read, so the identifier stays at the family default); new customers use 'Enroll Now'. Online payments are free, can be scheduled up to 30 days ahead, and post the same day before 5:00 p.m. CT (5:00-11:59 p.m. CT: processed next business day, credited that day); a pending payment can be changed or deleted before 5:00 p.m. CT on the posting day. 'Our system allows only one payment at a time' (scheduled.maxPending 1). Bank (checking or savings) only. AutoPay: enroll online or in the app, choose a checking or savings account and the amount; it pays on the due date or a date you choose that is on time, and begins after the next billing cycle (not modelled); amount options are not listed. Cancelling AutoPay is not described (family default). Paperless: Accounts tab left menu 'Enroll in Paperless Statements' (or the More menu > Paperless Statements); turn off on 'Manage Paperless Statements'; up to one billing cycle to take effect; a $1.99 fee may apply to each mailed paper statement. Closing: cannot be done online; call 888-295-5540 or chat from Contact Us. Phone payments: 888-295-5540, before 5 p.m. CT Mon-Fri for same-day credit. Mail: Bankcard Payment Processing, 1601 Dodge Street Stop 2210, Omaha, NE 68197-2210 (payments page; the account FAQ prints 1620 Dodge Street); overnight to the same address, Attention: Express Payments. Customer Service 888-295-5540 replaces the catalog number (888-530-3626). Late fees are not published on these pages. Review (t20): the AutoPay start rule and the one-payment-at-a-time rule are on the Personal Help Center page (sources moved there); the account FAQ does not state them.

guest_pay.note: FNBO online payments are made after you log in to your online account or the app. You can also pay by phone at 888-295-5540 or by mail.

autopay.note: AutoPay begins after your next billing cycle, so make any payment that is due now yourself.

cancel_service.note: Closing your account can't be done online. Call Customer Service at 888-295-5540 or chat with us from the Contact Us page.

help.title: Paying your FNBO credit card
paragraphs: Log in to your online account or the app to pay for free from any device. You can make a one-time payment or set up recurring monthly payments, and schedule a payment up to 30 days ahead. Pay at least the minimum payment due on your statement.

Payments submitted before 5:00 p.m. CT post the same day. Payments between 5:00 and 11:59 p.m. CT are processed the next business day but credited with the date you paid. You can change or delete a pending payment before 5:00 p.m. CT on the day it posts.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Enroll in AutoPay online or in the app, choose a checking or savings account and set the amount to deduct. It pays automatically each month on your due date, or on a date you choose as long as the payment is on time.
AutoPay begins after your next billing cycle. If a payment is due now, make it yourself.

help.title: Pay by phone or mail
paragraphs: By phone: call 888-295-5540; for same-day credit call before 5 p.m. CT, Monday through Friday.

By mail: put the payment coupon in the envelope that came with your statement and send it to Bankcard Payment Processing, 1601 Dodge Street Stop 2210, Omaha, NE 68197-2210. Allow a week for it to arrive. For overnight delivery use the same address with Attention: Express Payments.

help.title: Paperless statements and the paper statement fee
paragraphs: A $1.99 fee may be charged each time FNBO mails a monthly paper statement. To avoid it, log in, open the More menu and select Paperless Statements; if you don't have an online account yet, enroll first.
It can take up to one billing cycle for paperless to start. You can turn paperless off later on the Manage Paperless Statements page, but the paper statement fee may then apply.

help.title: Closing your account
paragraphs: Closing an account can't be done online. Call Customer Service at 888-295-5540 or use the chat on the Contact Us page.

help.title: Making more than one payment
paragraphs: FNBO's system handles one payment at a time. Wait until your current payment has fully processed before you submit another one. If you need to pay sooner, call Customer Service at 888-295-5540 to talk about your options.

extra.intent: Using FNBO's help pages, find the fee FNBO may charge for each mailed paper credit card statement. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
